theater: 高加索南北兩線與里海西岸

battle.name: 俄國-波斯戰爭 (1826年-1828年)
battle.theater: 高加索南北兩線與里海西岸
battle.brief: 一八二六年秋，阿拔斯米爾扎以大軍越過庫拉河，攻入舍拉罕與達吉斯坦；俄軍以縱隊反攻，帕斯凱維奇把十六門野砲集中在一翼，葉莉薩維特波爾一役以砲火撕開波斯中軍，埃里溫與巴庫相繼淪陷，最後以土庫曼恰伊條約割地賠款。卡面這門可拆成馬車拉走的野砲，正是把砲火帶上高加索山口的東西。

kit.name: 野砲
kit.history: 能拆成幾件馬車拉走的砲。它讓野戰第一次有了可以計算的砲火。

countries: 這場戰爭是俄羅斯帝國與卡扎爾波斯在一八二六年至一八二八年之間的高加索衝突，兩邊的指揮系統完全不是一套東西。俄方分南北兩條線：南線是外高加索軍團，駐軍極少，骨架是俄羅斯步兵營、頓河與烏拉爾哥薩克騎兵，以及格魯吉亞的伊姆雷蒂亞與古里亞民兵，由格魯吉亞貴族埃里斯塔維與達迪安尼兩家率領；北線是高加索線，由莫茲多克到基茲利亞爾的一串堡壘與哥薩克砲兵守著，另有自巴庫與皮亞齊戈爾斯克駛出的裏海砲艇分隊，控制里海西岸的航路。北線主將是亞歷克西·葉爾莫洛夫，南線在一八二七年起由伊凡·帕斯凱維奇接手，兩人分屬兩個指揮部，互不隸屬卻靠書信與駿馬協調。波斯一方是卡扎爾王朝的中央直轄軍：火砲園集中編制，直屬步兵按線列作戰，騎兵來自卡扎爾、庫巴、設拉子諸部，另有各地汗國的守軍與臨時徵召的部落兵。阿拔斯米爾扎以王儲身份統軍，往年各戰線互不統屬，軍餉常斷，糧道要繞德黑蘭與裏海東岸；俄方雖然兵少，靠堡壘、哥薩克與民兵互相咬合，把小股兵力反覆投在關鍵點上，靠這種辦法拉長戰線、拖住對手，也把波斯到北高加索的糧路一齊掐住。南線的俄軍駐地本來分散在第比利斯與耶利扎維多波爾兩點，兵少了反而要靠行軍速度取捨，帕斯凱維奇每一次調動都在數百里之間；波斯的中央直轄軍與各汗國守軍之間則沒有相通的指揮關係，一紙王命要走數日才能到達前線。
countriesEn: This war was a Caucasian conflict between the Russian Empire and Qajar Persia between 1826 and 1828, and the two sides ran command systems that had nothing in common. The Russians fought on two separate lines. The southern line was the Transcaucasian corps, where the permanent garrison was tiny: the core was Russian infantry battalions, Don and Ural Cossack cavalry, and the Georgian militias of Imereti and Guria, led by the Georgian noble houses of Eristavi and Dadiani. The northern line was the Caucasian Line, a chain of fortresses from Mozdok to Kizlyar manned by Cossack artillery and infantry, backed by a Caspian gunboat detachment of steamers built at Baku and Pyatigorsk that controlled the western shore of the sea. Alexei Yermolov commanded the northern line; Ivan Paskevich took over the southern one in 1827. The two sat in separate commands, neither subordinate to the other, and coordinated by letter and by fast horse across the mountains. On the Persian side stood the central army of the Qajar dynasty: a concentrated artillery park, line infantry fighting in regular order, cavalry drawn from the Qizilbash, Quba and Shiraz tribal formations, plus the garrisons of the khanates and hastily levied tribal levies. Abbas Mirza led as heir apparent, and the various fronts of the previous campaigns had never been subordinated to one another; pay was habitually in arrears, and the supply line had to run by way of Tehran and the eastern Caspian shore. The Russians, few in number, made their small force count by interlocking fortresses, Cossacks and local militias, repeatedly committing detachments to the decisive point, stretching the front line to hold the enemy in place, and at the same time strangling the Persian grain route to the northern Caucasus. The Russian southern force was based at two points, Tiflis and Elizavetpol, so a small army had to live on its own legs: every redeployment Paskevich ordered cost hundreds of kilometres of marching. Between the Persian central army and the garrisons of the khanates there was no shared chain of command at all, and a royal order took days to reach the front.
people: 阿拔斯米爾扎·卡扎爾是這場戰爭的樞紐。他是法特阿里沙阿的長子，一八二〇年代主持軍制改革：聘歐洲教官整頓線列步兵，建立德黑蘭的兵工廠與火藥廠，還辦起報紙宣傳新軍，並把火砲園整頓成可以集中使用的砲兵單位。一八二六年他以大軍越過庫拉河攻入舍拉罕與達吉斯坦；一八二七年二月，其叔父米爾札·哈桑汗在卡拉西夫附近陣亡，軍心隨之一挫；同年六月二十五日葉莉薩維特波爾一役，中軍被俄軍砲火撕開，他本人勉強脫身，此後大軍因欠餉而瓦解，一路散為盜匪。國王法特阿里沙阿坐鎮德黑蘭，最後由米爾札·阿布勒哈桑等臣僚代表波斯簽字，他本人至死未能再上戰場。俄方主將伊凡·帕斯凱維奇以區區數千兵深入，攻下阿哈爾卡爾基、德爾本特與巴庫，最後兵臨泰茲瑞；古里亞的達維德·埃里斯塔維親王率領十六門野砲，是葉莉薩維特波爾一役扭轉戰局的人；伊姆雷蒂亞的瓦赫坦·達迪安尼親王則在喬治亞邊境收拾殘局、掩護撤退。北線的亞歷克西·葉爾莫洛夫守住捷列克河線，但一八二七年給姆雷強攻的慘敗迫得他放棄深入達吉斯坦。德黑蘭那邊另有米爾札·塔基主持兵工與印刷，他主張重整軍令；英國使節哈福德·瓊斯·布里奇斯於一八二六年抵達德黑蘭促成英波條約，替波斯壯膽，也把俄國推向開戰。米爾札·阿加汗率庫巴軍攻入杰爾本特，侯賽因庫利汗則在達吉斯坦與阿瓦爾山區維持游擊，二人都未能扭轉局面；德黑蘭的歐洲顧問團則負責訓練火砲手與工兵，把新制軍隊的骨架搭起來。
peopleEn: Abbas Mirza Qajar was the pivot of the entire war. The eldest son of Fath-Ali Shah, he directed the military reforms of the 1820s: hiring European instructors to regularize his line infantry, establishing an arsenal and a powder works in Tehran, starting a newspaper to advertise the new army, and reorganising the artillery park into a unit that could be used in concentration. In 1826 he crossed the Kura with a great army and invaded Shirvan and Dagestan. In February 1827 his uncle Mirza Hasan Khan was killed near Karasif and the mood of the army sagged with it; on 25 June 1827, at the battle of Yelisavetpol, the Persian centre was torn open by Russian gunpowder and he barely escaped, and after that his army disintegrated for want of pay and spread across the country as bandits. Fath-Ali Shah remained in Tehran, and the treaty was eventually signed for Persia by such ministers as Mirza Abolhassan; the shah himself never came to the field again. The Russian commander Ivan Paskevich pushed forward with no more than a few thousand men, took Akhalkalaki, Derbent and Baku, and finally stood before Tabriz. Prince David Eristavi of Guria, who led sixteen field guns, was the man who turned the battle of Yelisavetpol; Prince Vakhtang Dadiani of Imereti gathered the broken pieces on the Georgian border and covered the retreat. On the northern line Alexei Yermolov held the Terek, but the disaster of the assault on Gimry in 1827 forced him to give up the plan of driving deep into Dagestan. In Tehran, Mirza Taqi ran the arsenal and the press and pressed for a reform of military orders. The British envoy Harford Jones-Brydges reached Tehran in 1826 and concluded an Anglo-Persian treaty, encouraging Persia and pushing Russia toward war. Mirza Agha Khan led the Quba troops into Derbent and Hussein Quli Khan kept up irregular fighting in Dagestan and the Avar mountains, and neither could turn the situation; the European instructors in Tehran meanwhile trained gun crews and engineers and built the skeleton of the reformed army.
kits: 卡面這門野砲是這場戰爭的真正骨幹。野砲的定義就是能拆成炮身、前車與炮架，馬匹分段拖曳，跟得上步兵縱隊；十六世紀定型，到一八二〇年代仍是野戰砲火的基本單位，攻城砲則另屬一套笨重的體系。俄軍使用六磅與十二磅野砲，配霰彈與實心彈，每門連同前車與彈藥車要六匹以上的馬，砲組與彈藥車合計一日要耗掉數百公斤飼料，於是砲兵在任何戰役裡都是最吃後勤的部門。葉莉薩維特波爾一役，十六門砲集中在高地上齊射，是切斷波斯縱隊的關鍵；北線的砲兵卻要在達吉斯坦山區拆成單件，由人夫抬過山口，德爾本特與巴庫的戰役則靠裏海砲艇分隊的船炮封鎖海岸、掩護陸路。波斯方的火砲園規模反而更大，口徑偏重，多為十二磅以上，部分購自歐洲或自奧斯曼繳獲，另有少量臼砲與攻城重炮混在陣列之中，但馬組不齊、火藥規格不一、射速緩慢，砲列常置於全線中央，一旦中軍被突破，砲車與輜重立刻成為最大的戰利品。步兵雙方都已是燧發槍配刺刀，俄軍另有射程更遠的米尼式步槍；騎兵則是哥薩克對卡扎爾與各部落騎兵。德黑蘭的兵工廠同時為火砲園造彈藥，北線的俄軍則靠莫茲多克與基茲利亞爾的軍械庫維持火藥存量，兩套後勤的差距，最後都變成同一條戰線上的差距。攻城方面反而沒有大型攻城砲可用：俄軍此役主要靠封鎖與奇襲取城，火砲用來打牆頭的守軍而不是拆牆；波斯火砲園中那些阿夫沙爾與塞法維時代留下來的重砲太重，運不動，只能留在堡壘裏當固定砲使用。
kitsEn: The field gun on the card is the real backbone of this war. A field gun is by definition a piece that can be broken into barrel, limber and carriage, dragged in separate sections by horses, and so keeps pace with an infantry column; the design was settled in the sixteenth century and was still the basic unit of field artillery in the 1820s, while siege guns belonged to a separate and far heavier system. The Russians used six- and twelve-pounder field guns firing canister and solid shot. Each gun, together with its limber and ammunition wagon, needed six horses or more, and a gun team with its wagons consumed several hundred kilograms of fodder a day, which made artillery the most logistically demanding arm in any campaign. At Yelisavetpol the sixteen guns massed on the heights and fired in salvo, and that salvo was what cut the Persian columns apart. On the northern line artillery had to be broken down further still, carried piece by piece on men's backs across the passes of Dagestan, while the campaigns against Derbent and Baku were supported by the ship-mounted guns of the Caspian detachment, which blockaded the coast and covered the advance overland. The Persian artillery park was in fact larger, of heavier calibre, mostly twelve-pounder and upwards, partly bought in Europe and partly captured from the Ottomans, with a few howitzers and heavy siege pieces mixed into the line, but its horse teams were uneven, its powder was not standardised, its rate of fire was slow, and the guns were habitually posted in the centre of the line: once the centre broke, the guns and baggage became the richest prize on the field. On foot both armies were by now flintlock infantry with bayonets, and the Russians added the longer-ranged Minié ball rifle; in the saddle it was Cossacks against Qizilbash and tribal cavalry. The arsenal in Tehran supplied the artillery park with its ammunition, while on the northern line the Russians kept their powder stocks at Mozdok and Kizlyar; the gap between the two logistics systems ended up as a gap on the same front. For the sieges there were no heavy siege guns to hand: the Russians took towns mainly by blockade and surprise, and the field guns were used to fire at the defenders on the walls rather than to batter them. The oldest Persian pieces, inherited from the Afshar and Safavid age, were too heavy to move and could only be used as fixed guns inside fortresses.
tactics: 俄軍的戰術核心是分進合擊加砲火集中。葉爾莫洛夫在北線以堡壘控住捷列克河，帕斯凱維奇在南線以小股縱隊在群山之間機動，兩人互相策應，把有限的兵力和寬正面用活了。行軍多採縱隊，宿營設柵，砲兵先展開佔位，步兵在後列陣；葉莉薩維特波爾一役的做法最典型：少量步兵與哥薩克分別黏住波斯兩翼，砲隊居高臨下先以齊射打散波斯密集的中央縱隊，然後步兵以刺刀推進，波斯陣線一裂，哥薩克立刻切斷退路，騎兵追擊直趨里海沿岸。波斯軍則是另一套：全線展開的長列陣，步兵居中、火砲置於陣中央、騎兵護兩翼，衝鋒前先以砲火壓制，再以密集騎兵反覆衝擊俄軍薄弱處；這種中央厚、兩翼薄的結構一旦中央被突破，全線就失去協同，剩下的部隊跟著解體。攻城方面俄軍以封鎖、斷糧與奇襲為主，德爾本特是一場奇襲，巴庫則在裏海砲艇封鎖海岸、守軍糧盡之後才開城。一八二七年之後波斯軍因欠餉散為盜匪，俄軍得以長驅直入，這也算戰術上的崩潰；而北線的教訓正相反：給姆雷的強攻證明山區不宜正面硬攻，俄軍此後改為沿庫拉河穩步推進。德爾本特與巴庫的取城方式正說明這一點：前者是趁夜色與守軍空隙的奇襲，後者是切斷海岸、耗盡糧援之後迫其開城；俄軍沿途就地徵糧、徵用牲畜，把遠征的成本壓在佔領區上。
tacticsEn: The core of Russian method was attack by concentration with the artillery concentrated as well. Yermolov held the Terek with fortresses on the northern line while Paskevich manoeuvred small columns through the mountains on the southern one, the two supporting each other and stretching a handful of men across a wide front. On the march the Russians moved in column, picketed their camps, and put the guns in position first with the infantry deployed behind them; the pattern at Yelisavetpol is the clearest example. A few hundred infantry and the Cossacks pinned the two Persian wings, the battery fired massed salvoes from the heights and broke up the dense Persian columns in the centre, and only then did the infantry advance with the bayonet. As soon as the Persian line split, Cossacks cut the retreat and the cavalry pursuit ran for the Caspian shore. The Persians ran a different system: a long deployed line with infantry in the middle, the artillery in the centre of the line and cavalry on the flanks, artillery fire to soften the enemy before a massed cavalry charge was sent against the thin Russian sectors. Such a structure, thick in the centre and thin on the wings, lost all coordination the moment the centre went, and the rest of the army came apart with it. In the sieges the Russians relied on blockade, famine and surprise: Derbent fell to a surprise attack, and Baku opened its gates only after the Caspian gunboats had closed the coast and the garrison had run out of food. After 1827 the Persian army, unpaid and scattered, dissolved into bandit bands and the Russians marched straight to the Caspian, which was in effect a tactical collapse as well. The northern line taught the opposite lesson: the assault on Gimry proved that mountains are not to be taken by frontal attack, and afterwards the Russians advanced steadily along the Kura instead. The way Derbent and Baku were taken makes the point: the first was a surprise carried out in the dark against a thin garrison, the second the result of closing the coast and wearing the defenders out until they opened the gates. The Russians requisitioned grain and animals as they marched, loading the cost of the expedition onto the country they occupied.
data: 時間線相當清楚：一八二六年九月波斯同時從舍拉罕與達吉斯坦兩個方向越境開戰；二七年春天帕斯凱維奇接手南線；二月米爾札·哈桑汗陣亡，六月二十五日葉莉薩維特波爾交戰，秋天俄軍攻下阿哈爾卡爾基與哈拉巴；二八年一月奇襲德爾本特，七月十日巴庫投降，二月俄軍進抵泰茲瑞，同月二十一日訂立條約，全程約一年半。兵力對比上，俄軍在南線的出戰兵力只有數千人，加上哥薩克與格魯吉亞民兵，砲兵十六門；波斯軍集結數萬，確數諸說並存，但普遍認為是俄軍數倍甚至十倍，其火砲數目以數十門計，葉莉薩維特波爾一役之後大批砲車與輜重淪為戰利品。數字最可靠的兩點是：其一，十六門砲這個數目在俄方史料中反覆出現；其二，賠款總額為五百萬盧布。裏海砲艇分隊初期約十數艘汽船改裝艇。北線的數字最模糊：一八二七年九月給姆雷強攻中俄軍先頭縱隊在山中被殲，死傷數百，具體人數難考，遂使深入達吉斯坦的計畫中止。另有兩項可以確定的推算：俄軍自舍拉罕向西南推進到泰茲瑞，路程逾五百公里；波斯在戰後被迫削減軍額，火砲園停擺，朝廷收入還要拿出五百萬盧布的賠款，這筆錢約等於波斯數年的歲收，具體折算諸說並存。
dataEn: The chronology is fairly clear. In September 1826 Persia crossed the frontier simultaneously from the Shirvan and Dagestan directions. In the spring of 1827 Paskevich took over the southern line; Mirza Hasan Khan was killed in February, Yelisavetpol was fought on 25 June, and in the autumn the Russians took Akhalkalaki and Kharaba. Derbent was surprised in January 1828, Baku surrendered on 10 July, the Russians reached Tabriz in February, and the treaty was concluded on 21 February, the whole business lasting about a year and a half. As for numbers, the Russian force that fought on the southern line was only a few thousand men, Cossacks and Georgian militia included, with sixteen guns in the artillery; the Persian army gathered tens of thousands, the exact figure being much disputed, but it is generally held to have been several times the Russian strength, perhaps tenfold, and its guns are counted in dozens, many of the gun carriages and wagons falling into Russian hands as prize after Yelisavetpol. Two figures are the most reliable: first, the number sixteen for the guns, which recurs throughout the Russian accounts; second, the indemnity, five million roubles. The Caspian detachment began with something like a dozen converted steamers. The numbers on the northern line are the vaguest of all: in the assault on Gimry in September 1827 the leading Russian column was destroyed in the mountains, with several hundred killed or wounded and the exact toll impossible to establish, which ended the plan of driving deep into Dagestan. Two estimates can also be offered with some confidence: the Russian advance from Shirvan south-west to Tabriz covered more than five hundred kilometres, and after the war Persia was forced to cut its military establishment, the artillery park was wound down, and the treasury had to find five million roubles, an amount equal to several years of Persian revenue by rough reckoning, though the exact conversion is much disputed.
cause: 打起來的原因是一連串沒有解決的舊賬。一八一三年古利斯坦條約把達吉斯坦、格魯吉亞、舍拉罕、卡拉巴赫、格亞尼亞、杰爾本特與巴庫割給俄國，並讓俄國取得在裏海保有艦隊的專利；一八二一年土庫曼恰伊條約又切走埃里溫與納希切萬，約定的賠款一直未付。俄國在格魯吉亞修公路、整頓行政、沿捷列克河與庫拉河一線修築堡壘，觸動了汗國地方勢力的地盤。波斯的火藥桶有二：一八二五年法特阿里沙阿頒令讓境內基督教徒與穆斯林地位相當，格魯吉亞人拒絕接受，俄國立刻以保護者姿態介入，英國也看到了可乘之機；一八二六年英國使節哈福德·瓊斯·布里奇斯抵達德黑蘭並簽下英波條約，帶來實際援助的承諾。與此同時，阿拔斯米爾扎的軍制改革告一段落：線列步兵、集中的火砲園、歐洲教官與德黑蘭的兵工廠，使波斯第一次有能力在西高加索打一場有計劃的戰爭。開戰前阿拔斯米爾扎提出的要求，是收回古利斯坦條約割走的全部土地，談判破裂，戰爭遂起，而裏海航權與格魯吉亞教會的處境，則令英俄兩方都不願退讓。還有一層是宮廷內部的較量：法特阿里沙阿於一八二六年病重，實際的備戰由王儲一手主持，主戰派因此聲勢漸盛；而阿拔斯米爾扎在德黑蘭練兵用歐洲人，卻不願讓歐洲人指揮自己的軍隊，這種半信半疑的態度，最後也反映在戰場上。
causeEn: The war grew out of a stack of old scores that had never been settled. The Treaty of Gulistan of 1813 had ceded Dagestan, Georgia, Shirvan, Karabakh, Ganja, Derbent and Baku to Russia, and had given Russia a monopoly on keeping a fleet in the Caspian. The Treaty of Turkmenchay of 1821 then cut off Erivan and Nakhichevan, and the indemnity agreed there was never paid. Russia built roads in Georgia, reformed the administration, and raised fortresses along the Terek and the Kura, encroaching on the territory of the khanate notables. Persia had two separate irritants. First, in 1825 Fath-Ali Shah decreed that Christians within the realm should hold the same status as Muslims; the Georgians refused to accept it, Russia immediately adopted the posture of a protector, and Britain saw an opening. Second, in 1826 the British envoy Harford Jones-Brydges reached Tehran and signed an Anglo-Persian treaty carrying the promise of real assistance. At the same time Abbas Mirza's military reform had come to an end: line infantry, a concentrated artillery park, European instructors and an arsenal in Tehran gave Persia, for the first time, the capacity to fight a planned war in the western Caucasus. Before hostilities opened Abbas Mirza demanded the return of all the territory the Treaty of Gulistan had taken away; the negotiations broke down, and war followed, with the Caspian navigation and the condition of the Georgian church giving neither Britain nor Russia room to back down. There was a struggle inside the court as well: Fath-Ali Shah grew seriously ill in 1826, the real preparation of the war was directed by the heir apparent, and the party favouring war grew stronger with him. Abbas Mirza used European men to drill his troops in Tehran, yet would not let Europeans command his army; that half-trusted attitude was visible on the field as well.
impact: 這場戰爭把高加索的版圖整個改寫。俄國拿到埃里溫與納希切萬，兼併巴庫、杰爾本特、舍拉罕、格亞尼亞與卡拉巴赫，外高加索省與後來的高加索總督區在這幾年成形，維多利亞到高加索線的邊界被推到阿拉斯河下游；裏海則成為俄國海軍的內湖，砲艇分隊成為日後黑海與裏海部署的先聲，羅致英國的戒心也由此而生。卡扎爾王朝則付出三樣代價：五百萬盧布賠款、龐大軍隊連同火砲園的損失，還有葉莉薩維特波爾一役之後的權威危機。欠餉而解體的波斯軍在各地化為散兵與盜匪，擾亂了整整兩年；阿拔斯米爾扎雖然在戰場上失敗，卻靠改革後的軍事遺產回國重整，兵工廠、炮兵學校與歐洲顧問制度被保留下來，日後一八三〇年代德黑蘭的變革正是在這條線上生長出來。格魯吉亞與亞塞拜疆的地方精英因此分成兩半，一部分轉向彼得堡效力，一部分流亡到德黑蘭。往後看，這場戰爭是俄土戰爭與一八三〇年基茲利亞爾戰役的伏筆；一八五六年《巴黎條約》更明文宣布一八二八年土庫曼恰伊條約中俄國取得的裏海權利無效。野砲的用法也在這幾年成熟：能拆成前車的砲讓遠征隊伍把火力帶上山口，這套後勤模式後來在克里米亞戰爭中被推到極致。格魯吉亞教會在俄國保護下得以擴張，歐洲傳教士也乘勢進入南高加索；與此同時，亞美尼亞與格魯吉亞的年輕人開始流亡到德黑蘭，尋找可以復國的旗號，這條線在下一個半世紀裡一直未斷。
impactEn: The war rewrote the map of the Caucasus. Russia gained Erivan and Nakhichevan and absorbed Baku, Derbent, Shirvan, Ganja and Karabakh; the Transcaucasian province and the later viceroyalty of the Caucasus took shape in these years, and the Victoria-Caucasian line was pushed down to the lower Araxes. The Caspian became a Russian naval lake, the gunboat detachment there was the forerunner of later deployments on both the Black Sea and the Caspian, and Britain's unease grew with it. The Qajar dynasty paid in three kinds of coin: five million roubles of indemnity, the loss of a great army together with its artillery park, and a crisis of authority after Yelisavetpol. The unpaid Persian army dissolved into stragglers and bandits across the country for two whole years. Abbas Mirza, defeated in the field, went home and rebuilt on the strength of his reformed military institutions; the arsenal, the artillery school and the system of European instructors were all kept, and the reforms in Tehran of the 1830s grew out of exactly that line. The local elites of Georgia and Azerbaijan were split in two, some serving Petersburg and some going into exile at Tehran. Looking further ahead, this war was the prelude to the Russo-Turkish War and to the campaign of Kizlyar in 1830, and in 1856 the Treaty of Paris expressly annulled the Caspian rights Russia had gained under the 1828 Treaty of Turkmenchay. The use of the field gun also matured during these years: a gun that could be broken into a limber let marching columns carry firepower into the mountain passes, and that logistic model was later pushed to its extreme in the Crimean War. The Georgian church expanded under Russian protection and European missionaries moved into the southern Caucasus; at the same time young men from Armenia and Georgia began to travel into exile at Tehran in search of a banner under which to return, and that thread was not cut for another century and a half.
result: 一八二八年二月二十一日《土庫曼恰伊條約》在兩國邊境的小村訂下：波斯割讓埃里溫與納希切萬，退出舍拉罕、格亞尼亞、卡拉巴赫、杰爾本特與巴庫等汗國，承認俄國在裏海保有海軍的專利，並支付五百萬盧布賠款；各汗國的波斯守軍與軍械限期撤走，波斯放棄對達吉斯坦、格魯吉亞與亞布哈茲的索求。戰局上，波斯主力在葉莉薩維特波爾崩潰，此後再無成建制的會戰，俄軍相繼佔領阿哈爾卡爾基、德爾本特與巴庫，兵鋒抵達泰茲瑞城下，阿拔斯米爾扎在城郊議和。北線則是另一種結局：葉爾莫洛夫守住了捷列克河與基茲利亞爾，卻因給姆雷一役折損，被迫放棄深入達吉斯坦的計畫，高加索線維持守勢直到一八三〇年。整體看，俄國以區區數千兵力贏下整場戰爭，取勝關鍵不在人數而在砲兵集中、騎兵遮斷與裏海封鎖三者的配合；卡扎爾波斯則第一次失去高加索的門戶，此後十餘年都在尋找恢復國力的方法，直到一八五〇年代連同高加索一起失去。條約之後俄軍一度進駐泰茲瑞，數月內撤回；阿拔斯米爾扎回德黑蘭重整火砲園、續聘歐洲教官，把損失的砲與人補回來。五年之後的一八三〇年基茲利亞爾戰役，俄軍正式奪取基茲利亞爾，北線的大門才算關上。
resultEn: On 21 February 1828 the Treaty of Turkmenchay was concluded in a small village on the border between the two states. Persia ceded Erivan and Nakhichevan, withdrew from the khanates of Shirvan, Ganja, Karabakh, Derbent and Baku, recognised Russia's exclusive right to keep a fleet in the Caspian, and agreed to pay five million roubles in indemnity; the Persian garrisons and their ordnance were to be withdrawn by an agreed term, and Persia gave up all claims to Dagestan, Georgia and Abkhazia. On the field, the main Persian army had collapsed at Yelisavetpol and there was never again a set-piece battle: the Russians took Akhalkalaki, Derbent and Baku in turn, reached the walls of Tabriz, and Abbas Mirza made his peace in the suburbs of the city. The northern line ended differently. Yermolov held the Terek and Kizlyar, but the losses at Gimry forced him to abandon his plan of driving deep into Dagestan, and the Caucasian Line stayed on the defensive into the 1830s. Taken as a whole, Russia won the entire war with a few thousand men, and the key was not numbers but the combination of concentrated artillery, cavalry interdiction and the Caspian blockade. Qajar Persia had lost the door to the Caucasus for the first time, and spent the next ten-odd years looking for a way to recover its strength, until the Caucasus itself was lost in the 1850s. After the treaty the Russians occupied Tabriz for a time and withdrew within months; Abbas Mirza went back to Tehran, rebuilt his artillery park and took on European instructors again to make good the guns and men he had lost. Five years later, in the campaign of Kizlyar in 1830, Russia took Kizlyar for good, and only then was the northern door closed.
